title: Grade 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #5

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   B. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Dua before and after waking up.? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dua before and after waking up..
   B. Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Dua before and after waking up. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Dua before and after waking up. has no place in daily life.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.
   D. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Milad un-Nabi? (1 mark)
   A. Use Milad un-Nabi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Milad un-Nabi.
   D. Say Milad un-Nabi has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.
   D. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Milad un-Nabi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Arabic alphabet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

3. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. A — Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

10. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Relationship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Milad un-Nabi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Arabic alphabet; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
